#### What's new

<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

The two fixes in this release address issues uncovered by the first live narration run (v0.93.0).

##### Bug fixes

The v0.93.0 candidate was rejected by the apply job because the narrative legitimately described the validator itself, using an inline code span containing `` `<details>` ``. The structural regex that guards against idempotency-marker or `<details>` forgery matched the code-quoted tag even though GitHub renders it as inert literal text. A new `stripCodeSpans()` helper blanks the contents of well-formed fenced code blocks and inline code spans before the `contains-marker` and `contains-details` checks run, leaving all other validation (empty body, oversized candidate, control characters, missing PR link) on the raw text. The fail-closed posture is preserved: an unbalanced backtick or unterminated fence leaves the raw text intact so a real tag hidden behind broken markup is still caught.
